outcome: Fetal kidney histopathological changes (H&E, Masson trichrome, Periodic acid shift staining)
cohort: The study included 48 pregnant Wistar albino rats weighing 200-250gr, divided into control and streptozotocin-induced diabetic groups, with their fetuses harvested at 15, 17, and 19 days of development.
finding: Diabetes adversely affected kidney development on the 15th day of development compared to other stages, and the immunoreactivity intensity of Urotensin II and TGF-beta1 was higher in the kidney tissues of fetuses from diabetic pregnant rats.
cross-section timing: Fetal tissues were harvested and examined at 15, 17, and 19 days of development.
